description_en: Retrieves the O&M configuration of a user, which currently includes proactive O&M window information
description_zh: 获取用户的运维配置信息，目前包括主动运维窗口信息
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-active-operation-maintain-conf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-re000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationMaintainConf

CreatedTime.description_en:
The creation time.

The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss format
CreatedTime.description_zh:
创建时间。

时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

CycleTime.description_en:
The cycle time.

If CycleType is set to Month, a number from 1 to 28 is returned, indicating the day of the month. Multiple values are separated by commas (,).
If CycleType is set to Week, a number from 1 to 7 is returned, indicating the day of the week. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
CycleTime.description_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接

CycleType.description_en:
The cycle type. Valid values:

Month: monthly
Week: weekly
CycleType.description_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周

MaintainEndTime.description_en:
The end time of the maintenance window.

The time is in UTC in the HH:mmZ format
MaintainEndTime.description_zh:
可维护截止时间。

时间为 UTC 时间，格式为 HH:mmZ

MaintainStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the maintenance window.

The time is in UTC. Example: 8:00Z
MaintainStartTime.description_zh:
可维护时间开始时间。

时间为 UTC 时间，示例为 8:00Z

ModifiedTime.description_en:
The modification time.

The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh:
修改时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Status.description_en: Indicates whether the configuration is effective. Valid values: 1 (yes) and 2 (no)
Status.description_zh: 是否生效 ,1 是 2 否
Status.title_en: 是否生效 ,1 是 2 否
Status.title_zh: 是否生效 ,1 是 2 否

HasConfig.description_en: Indicates whether the configuration has been set. Valid values: 1 (yes) and 0 (no). On the first visit, HasConfig is 0
HasConfig.description_zh: 是否配置过，1 是 0 否，首次访问hasConfig为0
HasConfig.title_en: 是否配置过，1 是 0 否，首次访问hasConfig为0
